CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub btnCosechar_Click()

    
   DoCmd.OpenForm "Frm_DatosCosecha", , , , , , 1
   Call recuperaRegistro1
   
End Sub

Private Sub Comando48_Click()
    DoCmd.OpenForm "Frm_DatosCosecha", , , , , , 2
   Call recuperaRegistro1
End Sub

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
    If Not CurrentProject.AllForms("Frm_Siembra").IsLoaded Then Cancel = True
End Sub

Private Sub btnEditar_Click()
    DoCmd.OpenForm "Frm_Datos", , , , , , 2
    Call recuperaRegistro
End Sub

Private Sub btnEliminar_Click()
    If MsgBox("¿ESTA SEGURO DE ELIMINAR EL REGISTRO?", vbOKCancel + vbInformation, "Aviso") = vbOK Then
        CurrentDb.Execute "DELETE * FROM programacionCultivos WHERE codigosistema = " & Me.txtId & "", dbFailOnError
    End If
    Me.Form.Requery
End Sub

Private Sub recuperaRegistro()
    Dim rst As DAO.Recordset, SQL As String
    
    On Error GoTo ManipulaError
    SQL = "SELECT * FROM programacionCultivos WHERE codigosistema = " & Me.txtId & ""
    Set rst = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(SQL, dbOpenForwardOnly)
    With rst
        Forms![Frm_Datos]![txtId] = !codigoSistema
        Forms![Frm_Datos]![txtCodSemilla] = !codsemilla
        Forms![Frm_Datos]![txtFecha] = !fechaSiembra
        Forms![Frm_Datos]![txtDescripcion] = !observaciones
        Forms![Frm_Datos]![txtCantidad] = !numeroPlantasSembradas
        Forms![Frm_Datos]![txtLote] = !lote
        Forms![Frm_Datos]![txtCama] = !cama
        Forms![Frm_Datos]![txtfactura] = !factura
        Forms![Frm_Datos]![txtActivo] = !activo
        
    End With
    rst.Close: Set rst = Nothing
    
Salir:
    Exit Sub
    
ManipulaError:
    If Not rst Is Nothing Then rst.Close: Set rst = Nothing
    MsgBox Err.Description, vbCritical, "Atencion"
    Resume Salir
End Sub

Private Sub recuperaRegistro1()
    Dim rst As DAO.Recordset, SQL As String
    
    On Error GoTo ManipulaError
    SQL = "SELECT * FROM programacionCultivos WHERE codigosistema = " & Me.txtId & ""
    Set rst = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(SQL, dbOpenForwardOnly)
    With rst
        Forms![Frm_DatosCosecha]![txtId] = !codigoSistema
      
    End With
    rst.Close: Set rst = Nothing
    
Salir:
    Exit Sub
    
ManipulaError:
    If Not rst Is Nothing Then rst.Close: Set rst = Nothing
    MsgBox Err.Description, vbCritical, "Atencion"
    Resume Salir
End Sub
